strategy.title: Subcontracted cold-chain prescription delivery for independent pharmacies via MedCourier
strategy.why: Price $180 and MedCourier's quoted cost $95 are evidenced, leaving $85 per delivery; 36 deliveries net $3,060. Buyers (35 county pharmacies) are reachable by published email, there is a posted buying signal, cash arrives within 7 days and MedCourier is paid only after each receipt settles, so no up-front capital is needed. The close rate among these pharmacy owners is not measured (the 22/200 pre-order figure is from site visitors, not this buyer list), so the plan is conditional on a live test.

reviews.reasons: CONDITIONAL is the right stance and economics check ($180-$95=$85; 36 deliveries net $3,060; trace matches; last settlement day 24; MedCourier is the recorded fulfiller; visitor pre-order rate correctly not transferred). But the proof/stop/continue rule does not partition the outcomes, and the stop statement is inaccurate.
findings: Stop is 'fewer than 2 pharmacies' and continue is '3 or more pharmacies and 10+ deliveries': exactly 2 pharmacies, or 3+ pharmacies with fewer than 10 deliveries, has no decision.
Stop says 'nothing has been spent' but batch 1 (10 deliveries, $950 owed to MedCourier) runs on day 3, before the day-10 test.

Per-pharmacy volume is unknown (card's 20/week may be the county total, making 36 deliveries ~55-60% of all county volume in the window); continue threshold should be stated as a run-rate that reaches 36 by the last delivery day that still settles by day 30 (~day 23).

reviews.reasons: All four prior findings resolved. One measured threshold (>=13 paid deliveries by day 10) partitions every outcome; the run rate ~1.8/day from day 3 reaches 36 by day 23, the last delivery day that settles inside 30. Batches 13+12+11=36; net $6,480-$3,420=$3,060 >= $3,000; last receipt settles day 27; MedCourier (recorded fulfiller) paid after settlement, max exposure 0; trace matches. strategy.title: Subcontracted cold-chain prescription delivery for independent pharmacies via MedCourier
strategy.why: Price $180 and MedCourier's quoted cost $95 are evidenced, leaving $85 per delivery; 36 deliveries net $3,060. Buyers (35 county pharmacies) are reachable by published email, there is a posted buying signal, cash arrives within 7 days and MedCourier is paid only after each receipt settles, so no up-front capital is needed. The close rate among these pharmacy owners is not measured (the 22/200 pre-order figure is from site visitors, not this buyer list), so the plan is conditional on a live test. The goal gives the owner no hours, so Brain sends the outreach and invoices; its SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE capabilities are NOT_CONNECTED today and must be connected before day 1, which is a stated precondition rather than an assumption.
